[[Elswyth's Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[The_Darkness_(boss)|The Darknesses]], [[boss]]es who can be found in [[The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==

*One of the following [[recurve bow]]s:
**[[Ascalon Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[John Verado]] or [[Bariel Darkroot]]
**[[Recurve Bow (weapon)|Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Dye Master Franjek]]
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[Dayoesh]], [[Pathfinder Mia]], or [[Cait]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Destroyer Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[recurve bow]]s:
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]

==Unique counterparts==
[[Guidance]], [[Forgotten Hornbow]], [[Vah's Hornbow]], [[Deldrimor Hornbow (unique)]], [[Ironwing Longbow]], [[Mallyx's Longbow]], and [[Tundoss' Shortbow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.

==Notes==
This bow used to belong to [[King Elswyth]], one of the ancient monarchs buried in the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]].
